purpose: Native integration of the shared design engine into the actual MES, not the prototype's business/login application.
maintainedAdaptations: adapter.ts native Shadow DOM lifecycle and atomic catalog application
validator.ts shared command-replay, catalog and local model inspection
catalog.ts exact-version finish/glass and pinned color texture mapping
assets.ts real authenticated MES upload/read gateway
visual-asset-storage portable SHA-256 for untrusted LAN HTTP and self-contained glTF preflight
ui-components exact model/LOD/color-texture reload and asynchronous disposal guards
layout-shell-desktop scoped template storage and ShadowRoot keyboard focus
build: node build.mjs; output dist includes browser engine and standalone headless Node validator
test: node --test adapter.test.mjs catalog.test.mjs assets.test.mjs; TypeScript project tsconfig.json; backend DrawingServiceTest, CatalogServiceTest and AssetServiceTest; real M1-AST HTTP/SQL/files scenario
runtimeDependency: Backend geometry validation requires configured Node >=22, installed locally at C:/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe. Browser output is self-contained.
buildDependencies: Prefer this package's declared dependencies; existing prototype dependency cache is a read-only build fallback. MES runtime does not depend on the prototype service.
factoryDrawingStatus: Native MES saved-version paper preview/export adapter is implemented; first UI recording and post-fix targeted tests exist; final post-fix browser regression remains pending.
